- `status-z` expected `b3b138…` did not match; current stable value is `6acd785b…` (68,565 entries, 11,959,391 bytes, identical across 3 runs). The cause (tree drift vs methodology) is not established, and no on-disk historic status file reproduces `b3b138…`.
- The provenance/moment of the prompt's expected anchor set is not stated in evidence; only HEAD/HEAD^/branch/index/executables/files reproduce.
- Whether the four `node-adapter-syntax-01.*` files were rewritten after the incident cannot be verified from current state (hashes match the incident record; `new_writes_to_original: 0` is the record's claim, not something I observed historically).
- `document-publication-baseline.json`'s 1,494 raw `239` substrings were not individually classified (spot-checked only); its single `backups` hit is a DIR-entry name.
- `bootstrap-prewrite-runroot.json` (41 MB) was not exhaustively read; `239` hits sampled were incidental substrings, and it contains no `backup_file_count`.
- No conclusion is drawn about gate status, acceptance, or whether the FIFO-blocked baseline can be re-run; the failure-detail file only instructs PRESERVE_IN_PLACE / DO_NOT_OPEN.
